Name: No More Duggy Holes
Author: chickensoulforthesoup
Description:
I enjoy the mines, the monsters, the combat. What I don't love, however, are the little holes left in the mine dirt floor after a duggy has popped out. So gross, so triggering. I combed through all the mine maps, including the frost levels, lava levels, slime levels, dino level, skull cavern, the quarry mine, and the volcano, and got rid of the duggy holes and anything else in the walls that resembled a cluster of small holes. Trypophobia is strong with me, y'all.

This mod includes the dangerous and dark versions of all the above type of mine floors.

No more disgusting wall holes with eyes peering out at you - yeesh.

This mod [u]does not[/u] remove the mineable holes in the Skull Cavern  that make you fall several levels nor any crater indents in the walls and floors.

This mod [u]does not[/u] work in tandem with other mods that modify the appearance of the mines. Monster mods ok!
